mapper.sql: a.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",a.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",a.DEV_ID AS "developerId",a.JOB_CD AS "jobCode", a.INPUT_BGN_DT AS "startDate",a.INPUT_END_DT AS "endDate",a.CTRT_MM AS "monthlyMm",a.BILL_UPRC AS "billingPrice", a.INPUT_TYPE_CD AS "inputTypeCode",a.CTRT_DEV_ID AS "contractDeveloperId",a.EXT_PSBL_CD AS "extensionPossibilityCode", a.EXT_CNT AS "extensionCount",a.EARLY_WTHDR_YN AS "earlyYn",a.ASGN_STAT_CD AS "statusCode",COALESCE(a.MOD_DTTM,a.REG_DTTM) AS "modifiedAt", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName",d.DEV_NM AS "name",d.MNG_NO AS "managementNumber",COALESCE(j.CODE_NM,a.JOB_CD) AS "jobName", p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode",p.PROJ_STAT_CD AS "projectStatusCode"
FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=a.PROJ_ID JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.DEV_ID=a.DEV_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND j.CODE=a.JOB_CD
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY a.INPUT_BGN_DT ASC,a.ASGN_ID ASC
SELECT WHERE a.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD<>'CNCL' ORDER BY a.INPUT_BGN_DT ASC,a.ASGN_ID ASC
SELECT WHERE a.ASGN_ID=#{id}
SELECT WHERE a.ASGN_ID=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF a
SELECT ASGN_ID FROM TB_PJ_ASGN ORDER BY ASGN_ID
mapper.sql: HIST_SN AS "sequence",ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",ASGN_CHG_TYPE_CD AS "type",APLY_DT AS "effectiveDate", COALESCE(BFR_VAL,'') AS "beforeValue",COALESCE(AFT_VAL,'') AS "afterValue",ASGN_CHG_RSN_CD AS "reasonCode",COALESCE(CHG_MEMO,'') AS "memo", NEW_UPRC AS "price",NEW_CTRT_MM AS "mm",RTRO_YN AS "retroactiveYn",CLOSE_CROSS_YN AS "closedYn",CRCT_YN AS "correctedYn",CRCT_TRGT_SN AS "target",REG_USER_ID AS "actor",REG_DTTM AS "registeredAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST WHERE ASGN_ID=#{id} ORDER BY REG_DTTM DESC,HIST_SN DESC

SELECT to_char(m.ym,'YYYYMM') AS "month", COALESCE((SELECT h.NEW_CTRT_MM FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST h WHERE h.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND h.ASGN_CHG_TYPE_CD IN ('INPUT','RATE') AND h.NEW_CTRT_MM IS NOT NULL AND date_trunc('month',h.APLY_DT::timestamp) <= m.ym ORDER BY date_trunc('month',h.APLY_DT::timestamp) DESC,h.HIST_SN DESC LIMIT 1),a.CTRT_MM) AS "monthlyMm", COALESCE((SELECT h.NEW_UPRC FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST h WHERE h.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND h.ASGN_CHG_TYPE_CD IN ('INPUT','UPRC') AND h.NEW_UPRC IS NOT NULL AND date_trunc('month',h.APLY_DT::timestamp) <= m.ym ORDER BY date_trunc('month',h.APLY_DT::timestamp) DESC,h.HIST_SN DESC LIMIT 1),a.BILL_UPRC) AS "billingPrice" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(date_trunc('month',a.INPUT_BGN_DT::timestamp),date_trunc('month',a.INPUT_END_DT::timestamp),interval '1 month') AS m(ym) WHERE a.ASGN_ID=#{id} ORDER BY m.ym
SELECT FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST WHERE ASGN_ID=#{id} AND HIST_SN=#{sequence} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(HIST_SN),0)+1 FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST WHERE ASGN_ID=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST SET CRCT_YN='Y' WHERE ASGN_ID=#{assignmentId} AND HIST_SN=#{sequence} AND CRCT_YN='N' AND REG_DTTM IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{token,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
mapper.sql: SELECT t.TENT_ID::text AS "candidateId",p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName",t.DEV_ID AS "developerId",d.DEV_NM AS "name",n.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",COALESCE(c.CODE_NM,n.JOB_CD) AS "jobName",t.BGN_YM AS "month",n.PRD_MCNT AS "months",p.CTRT_BGN_DT AS "projectStart",p.CTRT_END_DT AS "projectEnd",t.TENT_STAT_CD AS "statusCode",d.MNG_NO AS "managementNumber",COALESCE(t.MOD_DTTM,t.REG_DTTM) AS "modifiedAt" FROM TB_SL_TENT_ASGN t JOIN TB_SL_OPP o ON o.OPP_ID=t.OPP_ID AND o.OPP_STAT_CD='WIN' JOIN TB_SL_OPP_NEED n ON n.OPP_ID=t.OPP_ID AND n.NEED_SN=t.NEED_SN JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=o.PROJ_ID JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.DEV_ID=t.DEV_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND c.CODE=n.JOB_CD
mapper.select: WHERE t.TENT_STAT_CD='CNVT' AND p.PROJ_STAT_CD IN ('ING','PRE') AND d.DRCT_CLS_CD<>'INDRCT' ORDER BY t.TENT_ID
WHERE t.TENT_ID=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND t.TENT_STAT_CD IN ('CNVT','DONE','DROP') FOR UPDATE OF t
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_HR_DEV WHERE DEV_ID=#{id} AND DRCT_CLS_CD='INDRCT')
SELECT DEV_ID AS "id",DEV_NM AS "name",USE_YN AS "useYn",DRCT_CLS_CD AS "directClassCode" FROM TB_HR_DEV WHERE MNG_NO=#{managementNumber}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SL_TENT_ASGN SET TENT_STAT_CD='DONE',PROC_DTTM=clock_timestamp(),MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp(),MOD_USER_ID=#{actor} WHERE TENT_ID=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND TENT_STAT_CD='CNVT'
UPDATE TB_SL_TENT_ASGN SET TENT_STAT_CD='DROP',PROC_DTTM=clock_timestamp(),MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp(),MOD_USER_ID=#{actor} WHERE TENT_ID=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND TENT_STAT_CD='CNVT'
mapper.select: SELECT d.DEV_ID AS "developerId",d.DEV_NM AS "name",COALESCE((SELECT pay.EMP_TYPE_CD FROM TB_HR_MON_PAY pay WHERE pay.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND pay.PAY_YM=#{month}),d.EMP_TYPE_CD) AS "employeeTypeCode",d.PART_ID AS "partId",p.PART_NM AS "partName",d.RETIRE_DT AS "retirementDate", (SELECT MON_UPRC FROM TB_HR_DEV_PRC r WHERE r.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND r.APLY_BGN_YM <= #{month} AND (r.APLY_END_YM IS NULL OR r.APLY_END_YM >= #{month}) ORDER BY r.APLY_BGN_YM DESC LIMIT 1) AS "defaultPrice", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT s WHERE s.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND s.WORK_STAT_CD='LEAVE' AND s.BGN_DT <= #{end} AND (s.END_DT IS NULL OR s.END_DT >= #{start})) AS "onLeave" FROM TB_HR_DEV d LEFT JOIN TB_BS_PART p ON p.PART_ID=d.PART_ID WHERE d.DEV_ID=#{id} AND d.USE_YN='Y'
SELECT CLOSE_YM FROM TB_CL_CLOSE WHERE CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE' ORDER BY CLOSE_YM
SELECT ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",COALESCE(SUM(MON_MM),0) AS "value" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON WHERE ASGN_ID IN AND substring(INPUT_YM,1,4)=CAST(#{year} AS text) GROUP BY ASGN_ID

SELECT a.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",COALESCE(MAX(x.total),0) AS "value" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN (SELECT m.DEV_ID,m.INPUT_YM,SUM(m.MON_MM) AS total FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN s ON s.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID AND s.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' WHERE substring(m.INPUT_YM,1,4)=CAST(#{year} AS text) AND m.DEV_ID IN (SELECT DEV_ID FROM TB_PJ_ASGN WHERE ASGN_ID IN ) GROUP BY m.DEV_ID,m.INPUT_YM) x ON x.DEV_ID=a.DEV_ID AND x.INPUT_YM BETWEEN to_char(a.INPUT_BGN_DT,'YYYYMM') AND to_char(a.INPUT_END_DT,'YYYYMM') WHERE a.ASGN_ID IN GROUP BY a.ASGN_ID
SELECT ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",COUNT(*)::int AS "value" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST WHERE ASGN_ID IN GROUP BY ASGN_ID
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB WHERE PROJ_ID=#{projectId} AND DEV_ID=#{developerId} AND DSTRB_STEP_CD='PLAN')
mapper.sql: FIX_YN='N' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.CLOSE_YM=INPUT_YM AND c.CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON WHERE ASGN_ID=#{id} AND INPUT_YM >= #{from} AND
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PJ_ASGN_MON (ASGN_ID,INPUT_YM,DEV_ID,PROJ_ID,INPUT_DAY_CNT,MON_MM,APLY_UPRC,SALES_AMT,FIX_YN,REG_USER_ID,REG_DTTM) VALUES(#{assignmentId},#{month},#{developerId},#{projectId},#{days},#{mm},#{price},#{sales},'N',#{actor},clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT (ASGN_ID,INPUT_YM) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT APLY_UPRC FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON WHERE ASGN_ID=#{id} ORDER BY INPUT_YM DESC LIMIT 1
